source: Original ARM32 libraftpirates.so; title.xml, login_registration.xml, HudButton.xml
observations: SetSoundEnabled writes both volumes to 0 or 1, then public wrapper saves
Title calls lua_sys.playMP3 with extensionless basename
adapter: Desktop uses SDL_mixer master volumes; Android uses Java music volume and suppresses new effects while muted. Saved sound flag uses a new one-byte settings file; not original save ABI. Retry/PCM diagnostic are portable debugging functionality.
limitations: Exact per-menu scripts and battle track transitions incomplete; native Windows playback not verified.
